verdict.rationale: Babylon.js documents an NPM package ecosystem, DCC exporters (3ds Max, Maya, Blender), broad format support (glTF, OBJ, STL), and community tools like the Playground, Sandbox viewer, and React integration, which support asset pipeline workflows. However there is no evidence of a dedicated asset store or marketplace of ready-made models/plugins comparable to Unity/Unreal asset stores, and a hands-on comment notes users porting to Godot for a 'proper game engine' project, suggesting the ecosystem is thinner for large-scale asset needs. Missing for 10: a curated marketplace/asset store, third-party plugin directory, and independent evidence of a broad ready-made asset ecosystem.
